types of research: We used a remote-controlled (RC) truck to contribute to the development of CCAM safety assurance framework in a European project called SUNRISE; We used a RC-car to investigate the adaptation of an automotive domain standard (SOTIF: ISO 21448:2022) to the forestry domain in a European project called AGRARSENSE; We used an RC-drone to collect data for generation of traffic scenarios in a European project called SYNERGIES; We used a simulated-truck to develop an AI-assisted framework for cybersecurity assessment in a Swedish Vinnova project called PRECISE; Limits on RO control which investigate what the remote operator should be allowed to do, under which conditions, and when control must be limited or withdrawn? Considers how latency, packet loss, workload, interface design, and limited situational awareness affect safe remote control; Tailoring and assessing the RO ODD: How can remote-operation ODD be defined for a specific use case. Beyond road, traffic, and weather, it should include connectivity, latency, video quality, operator workload, fallback options, and system limits. Assessment can combine safety-case work, ODD templates, simulation, stress testing, and field trials.
